warnings: THE VERTICAL CHAIN CLOSES EXACTLY, WHICH IS WHY THESE LEVELS ARE TRUSTED: 0.60 (ground to floor 1) + 3.40 (floor 1 to floor 2) + 3.10 (floor 2 to อะเส) + 2.55 (อะเส to อกไก่) = 9.65, matching the printed ระดับหลังอกไก่ +9.65 to the centimetre. Every level on this sheet is recorded as printed rather than inferred.

*** CONTRADICTION WITH S-02 ON THE RIDGE LEVEL, AND THE READING TAKEN IS +9.65. *** This sheet prints ระดับหลังอกไก่ +9.65 and backs it with the closing chain above. S-02 (หน้า21) notes หลังคาไก่ +10.00 ม. on the main roof and +8.40 ม. on the lower one. The two cannot be the same point. A-06's figure is dimensioned and self-checking; S-02's is a bare note. +9.65 is recorded here and +10.00 stays recorded on S-02's own file as printed, with this warning on both, so the disagreement is preserved rather than silently resolved. A later pass on the full-size sheets should settle whether S-02's +10.00 is the top of the ridge cap tile (making the ~0.35 m difference the covering) or an error.
ROOF PITCH IS 35 DEGREES, printed on both elevations against the hip line.
THE HORIZONTAL CHAIN ON THIS ELEVATION IS THE x GRID AND MATCHES THE MASTER: 1.00 eave + 3.50 + 2.20 + 3.00 + 1.00 eave, with 8.70 printed across grids 1 to 4 and the four bubbles drawn beneath.

Door and window marks (ป/น) appear on the elevation too but are not transcribed here, for the same reason as A-04/A-05 - the glyphs are too small on this scan to distinguish reliably and A-14/A-15 carry the authoritative schedule.
This file is one of three views on หน้า07 per §3; the others are รูปด้าน 2 and the two roof enlargements.

OPENING VOCABULARY RESOLVED ON A-14/A-15 (หน้า15, หน้า16). This file records no ป/น marks because the glyphs are unreadable at this scan's resolution. The schedules give the full closed list - eight door types ป1-ป8 and nine window types น1-น9, seventeen marks - so any later pass adding positions to this sheet has a fixed vocabulary to match against and cannot invent a mark. What is still missing is only WHICH type sits in WHICH opening on this drawing.
